entry.title: I built a CLI that scans, validates and audits your .env files and it works with any stack

razify validate .env .env.example
Catches missing required variables before you deploy. - name: Validate environment run: razify validate .env .env.example --json
razify guard install

# Windows scoop install razify
# Go users go install github.com/Hossiy21/razify@latest
